note: The input JSON string token for the Monster name field becomes the parser string value used to build the FlatBuffer.
The input-controlled string is serialized and its offset is stored as the parsed field value.
The stored offset is converted back to an offset while constructing the Monster table.
The generated-text path trusts the field presence decision without any additional initialization-state check for the bytes that will be printed.
For the present string field, the table offset is resolved to the serialized String object.
GenerateText reads bytes from the serialized string and passes them to EscapeString, where MemorySanitizer observes the target uninitialized-value use on the vulnerable path.
